title: Elastic ODYN: Differentiable Optimization for Infeasible Control and Learning in Robotics
abstract: arXiv:2606.16564v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotic systems routinely encounter conflicting objectives, modeling errors, and degenerate contact conditions that render quadratic programs (QPs) infeasible. Yet most optimization solvers and differentiable QP layers assume feasibility, leading to numerical failures, unstable gradients, or solver breakdown when constraints cannot be simultaneously satisfied. We present Elastic ODYN, a primal-dual non-interior-point QP solver that handles infeasibility through smooth squared-$\ell_2$ elastic relaxations. translated_title: Elastic ODYN：面向机器人中不可行控制与学习的可微分优化
translated_abstract: 机器人系统在日常运行中经常遇到目标冲突、建模误差和退化接触条件，这些问题会导致二次规划（QP）不可行。然而，大多数优化求解器和可微分QP层都假设问题可行，当约束无法同时满足时，会导致数值失败、梯度不稳定或求解器崩溃。我们提出了Elastic ODYN，一种原始-对偶非内点QP求解器，通过平滑的平方ℓ₂弹性松弛来处理不可行性。该公式在病态和退化条件下仍保持良好的适定性，支持热启动，并收敛到最接近可行的解，同时通过轻量级细化恢复具有物理意义的对偶变量。基于此框架，我们开发了Elastic ODYNLayer——一个在不可行条件下仍具有稳定梯度的可微分QP层，以及Elastic OdynSQP——一种能够解决不一致子问题与不可行问题的SQP方法。
tldr: 提出Elastic ODYN系列框架（包括QP求解器、可微分QP层和SQP方法），通过平滑的弹性松弛技术，使机器人在不可行、病态和退化条件下仍能实现数值稳定且梯度可靠的可微分优化。
en_tdlr: Elastic ODYN introduces a QP solver, a differentiable QP layer, and an SQP method that remain stable and produce reliable gradients under infeasible, ill-conditioned, and degenerate conditions through smooth squared-ℓ2 elastic relaxations.
